threadDescriptions.glare-control: Reduce afternoon glare on the shared remote-work desk's screen
threadDescriptions.input-layout: Arrange keyboard, pointing device and document holder for comfortable remote work
threadDescriptions.shared-desk-handover: Make the shared work desk easy to reset between two household users
threadDescriptions.video-lighting: Improve face lighting for remote video meetings
threadDescriptions.piano-tuning: Arrange and verify tuning of the household upright piano

items.text: Afternoon workroom glare: window reflection sits over the spreadsheet totals. Start by rotating the desk a quarter turn, keeping the window to the side.
Shared desk handover annoys us both: Rui moves the chair and I lose the keyboard position. Make two simple setup cards with photos of our preferred arrangements.
Keyboard tray leaves the mouse too far right. Try the compact keyboard on the desktop and place the mouse close beside it.
Video-call preview: my face is dark against the bright window. Test the small diffused lamp beside the webcam rather than increasing screen brightness.
Quarter-turn desk trial leaves the reflection unchanged because the side cabinet mirror catches the window. Cover that mirror temporarily and retest the glare before moving furniture again.
items.rationale: Revises initial glare intervention based on observed source.

items.text: Make the compact-keyboard and close-mouse positions comfortable first, then photograph them for my shared-desk reset card. I tried moving the mouse inward while keeping the wide keyboard, but my hand kept hitting the number pad. The smaller keyboard gives that space back without changing the desk itself. Check the cable slack at the new position; yesterday it pulled the mouse toward the back corner halfway through editing. Rui needs a separate picture showing the larger keyboard, because the number pad is useful for their work. We should each do a reset from the other person's arrangement, using only the pictures, and note anything that requires guessing. Put the unused keyboard in the side cubby with its connector visible. The handover should preserve both workable arrangements even when we swap during a short lunch break.
items.rationale: Tunes input layout and records both reset configurations.

items.text: Call-light test with diffuser: even face exposure, but a bright circle reflects in glasses. Shift the lamp higher and farther left.
Covered mirror test at 15:00 cleared the reflection from spreadsheet totals. Fit a removable fabric panel over the mirror during afternoon work.
items.rationale: Confirms glare source and selects remedy.

items.text: Document holder on the left forces repeated head turns while typing. Put it between keyboard and screen, with the page top low enough not to hide the display.
Piano tuning enquiry: upright near the workroom door has two wavering notes around middle C. Ask the tuner to check the sticking soft pedal too.
Reset cards printed: Rui's has the wide keyboard, mine the compact one. Store the unused keyboard upright in the side cubby and leave the cable accessible.
items.rationale: Shared desk handover materials and storage.

items.text: Higher call lamp removes the glasses reflection. Mark its swivel position so camera lighting can be restored before meetings.
Near the door / left one / too high
items.rationale: Several nearby objects could fit this fragment.

items.text: Tuner booked Wednesday morning. Move the workroom chair away from the upright so the front panel and pedal assembly are accessible.
items.rationale: Piano service preparation; chair mention incidental.

items.text: Fabric mirror panel blocks glare but its loose edge brushes the screen. Clip the bottom corners so it stays flat during afternoon work.
Input-layout check after a long editing session: close mouse is easier to reach, document holder stays readable. Keep the compact keyboard and remove the unused tray from the setup plan.
Rui reset the shared desk from the photo in under two minutes. Add where the document holder is stored; that was the only missing instruction.
Upright tuning completed; wavering middle notes now stable. Soft pedal linkage adjusted and tested quietly with the tuner before paying.
Call lighting at dusk needs a lower lamp setting than midday. Save two labelled brightness positions beside the swivel mark.
items.rationale: Video lighting for differing ambient conditions.

items.text: Shared workroom handover cards updated with holder storage and cable path. Both users tried the revised instructions successfully this evening.

undo.reason: Hypothetical undo of a chair-placement match: the movement provides access for the piano tuner, not between-user desk reset.
